However, several claims are inaccurate or poorly supported, and the headline overstates.","problems":["Headline says 99215 is far above expected 'in every complexity stratum'; the card shows share above all-provider share in each stratum, but 'expected' is not given per stratum, and 0-condition rate of 8% vs 2.2% is a different comparison. Loosely worded.","'Against 9% for the comparison providers' for below-billed rate: the card gives 0.091 for all-provider 99215 rate, which is okay, but 'every documented 99215 supports the billed level' is overstated: only 4 examples shown and minutes often not recorded.","Note-check figures (problems 31%, late 9%, unsigned 0%, data 4%) are not on the card; 31 is flagged unmatched and cannot be verified; 'one in eight notes show repeated time' is also not on the card.","C0211682 cited as an example of moderate-plus data review with no lab line, but the card does not identify which claims are in the 3 of 34; unsupported citation.","Mentions 'back-pain visits' as a starting point, yet only URI and UTI were described; also C0211712 (18-year-old CKD) as pointing to a sicker panel is speculative inference from high MDM.","Next steps are generic and the formatted example claims are two bland low-complexity examples; the specific URI/UTI claims are not in the cited list; the EHR audit trail request appears only in the rationale, not in next_steps.","Interpretation that the 18-year-old's high MDM suggests a sicker panel is reasoning beyond the evidence."]}
